purpose: Historical confirmed-defect recall expectations. Search pressure only; never current-artifact proof.

cases.historicalSymptom: Visible arenas exceed delivered concurrent capacity.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume historical capacity values apply to the current artifact.

cases.historicalSymptom: Gameplay declares/depends on remote residency but required arena residency is not created.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not treat declaration/config presence as proof of runtime ownership.

cases.historicalSymptom: Reconnect path misses a fresh-session inventory reset/clear performed by the normal path.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not infer current failure from historical handler names.

cases.historicalSymptom: Reconnect recovery conflicts with pending death/respawn ownership.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not claim ordering without source-grounded overlap.

cases.historicalSymptom: Arena can become reusable while old reset/deferred cleanup still owns mutable state.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not require runtime if source ordering already permits stale commit.

cases.historicalSymptom: Pending/retry work can escape outstanding accounting and allow premature completion or stuck progression.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not equate spawn request with completed work.

cases.historicalSymptom: Global selector/tag/state is reachable from arena-local gameplay.
cases.expectedProofMethod: Reverse state index + selector scope ownership
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume selector intent from naming.

cases.historicalSymptom: Ordinary player can reach a debug/skip/restart affordance.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not classify unreachable developer code as a gameplay defect.

cases.historicalSymptom: One repeated arena/region is structurally incomplete compared with the canonical baseline.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume physical replicas are equivalent.

cases.historicalSymptom: Two reachable terminal triggers can both commit non-idempotent consequences.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not treat nearby ended-state code as Blocking Proof unless it guards the exact commit.

cases.historicalSymptom: Resources from a previous station remain in a reused gameplay chest and bypass the next station's economy contract.
cases.expectedDetectionCheck: Stage Transition State Check + Container & Economy Reset Check
cases.expectedCrosscheck: Previous-stage Mutation Footprint × Next-stage Allowed Resource Set
cases.expectedProofMethod: Resource provenance ledger + mutation/reset differential + transition ordering
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume a configured clear call is effective without checking later structure/world writers and the exact handoff order.

cases.historicalSymptom: A block restored by one stage remains in shared geometry and the next stage's actors cannot remove or traverse it.
cases.expectedDetectionCheck: Shared World State Check + Stage Transition State Check
cases.expectedCrosscheck: Previous-stage World Mutation × Next-stage Route × Actor Interaction Capability
cases.expectedProofMethod: Geometry overlap + restore owner + next-stage route dependency + break/use allowlist
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not inspect each stage in isolation when they reuse the same physical space.

cases.historicalSymptom: A carried objective remains logically owned by an offline player while its world/base representation is missing.
cases.expectedDetectionCheck: Carried Objective Ownership Check + Disconnect / Reconnect Check
cases.expectedProofMethod: Custody state machine + disconnect handler + exclusivity invariant
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not treat death cleanup as proof that disconnect cleanup exists.

cases.historicalSymptom: A gameplay cinematic or timer completes while the required player is offline and starts downstream gameplay with incomplete transition assumptions.
cases.expectedDetectionCheck: Offline Progression Check + Disconnect / Reconnect Check
cases.expectedCrosscheck: Player Online/Eligible State × Timer/Cinematic Completion × Downstream Initialization
cases.expectedProofMethod: Temporal proof + participant ownership + reconnect differential
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume a persisted timer is safe merely because reconnect restores the latest state.

cases.historicalSymptom: NPC attacks a blocking world object but only the attacker animates; the targeted block has no progress cue.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not promote to gameplay BUG unless missing feedback contradicts authored requirements or blocks play; otherwise retain as DEV NOTE.

updateSource: Circuit manual runtime findings converted into generalized regression pressure; historical cases remain search pressure only.
namingPolicy: Regression cases preserve historical symptoms, but expectedDetectionCheck must use canonical check names. Historical wording never creates a new audit family.
